newsitem.title: QATAR: SQUASH-JANSHER FACES EYLES AGAIN IN QATAR FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SQUASH-JANSHER FACES EYLES AGAIN IN QATAR FINAL.

text.p: World number one Jansher Khan and Australian rival Rodney Eyles will contest the Qatar International squash final for the third time in a row after winning their semifinals on Wednesday.
Jansher, seven times world champion, beat Eyles in the last two Qatar finals and will aim to win the title for the fifth consecutive time on Thursday.
Pakistan's Jansher, seven times world champion, defeated unseeded Frenchman Julien Bonetat 15-8 15-11 15-8 in the first semifinal, which lasted 53 minutes.
Eyles, who inflicted a rare defeat on Jansher in the Hong Kong Open final in August, beat fifth-seeded Chris Walker of England 17-16 15-10 11-15 15-10 in 61 minutes.
Jansher had been surprisingly sluggish in his earlier matches.
He needed five games to get past Egypt's Ahmed Barada in the second round and four to beat England's Simon Parke in the quarter-finals.
"I played my best match of the week today," Jansher said. "I felt very tired in the earlier rounds and lost concentration. But today when I had the chance to kill the ball I took it."
